about: Galgotias University is a private university established in 2011 by Suneel Galgotia on the Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida. The campus spans over 52 acres and includes modern engineering, management, law and pharmacy facilities. This AI assistant helps students quickly access timetables, notices, attendance, fees, portal links, and campus services.

fees.general: Semester tuition fees vary by program; most undergraduate engineering programs range from ₹1.7 lakh to ₹2.5 lakh per year. Check the portal for your exact fee details.
